name: ERP 连接器(示例)
description: 连接器模式示例:订单查询面板 + erp_query_orders 工具,mock 数据演示外部业务系统接入形态

tools.name: erp_query_orders
tools.description: Query ERP orders. Optional status filter (pending/paid/shipped/done). Returns order lines with customer, amount and status.

status.description: Filter by status: pending | paid | shipped | done

keyword.description: Filter by customer or order number keyword

tools.name: erp_fetch_live
tools.description: Fetch live order data from the configured ERP API endpoint over HTTP (network.fetch capability). Falls back to the local mock when the endpoint is unreachable.

url.description: API URL to fetch (host must be granted in the manifest)
